issues.title: Missing router import causes undefined variable error in BookerWebWrapper
issues.description: The `useRouter` hook is removed from the imports but the `router` variable is still used in multiple places within the component (lines 193, 228, 233, 239). This will cause a ReferenceError at runtime when any of these code paths are executed, such as when toggling the overlay calendar, navigating for instant meetings, or handling calendar interactions. The router is critical for navigation functionality in the booking flow.

issues.title: Incorrect priority sorting in sortHosts breaks round-robin host assignment
issues.description: The priority comparison logic is inverted when weights are equal in round-robin mode. The code now returns `priorityA - priorityB` instead of `priorityB - priorityA`, which sorts hosts in ascending priority order (lowest priority first) instead of descending (highest priority first). This causes lower-priority hosts to be selected before higher-priority hosts when weights are equal, breaking the intended assignment logic throughout the application wherever host assignment is used.

issues.title: Missing module resolution in dynamic import causes team assignment tab to fail
issues.description: The EventTeamAssignmentTab dynamic import is missing the `.then((mod) => mod)` module resolution that all other tab imports use. This inconsistency will cause the dynamic import to not properly extract the default export, resulting in the team assignment tab failing to render correctly. When users navigate to the team assignment tab for event types, they will encounter a blank screen or rendering error because the component cannot be properly loaded.

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #26629: refactor: move WebWrapper files from packages/platform to apps/web/modules
pr.author: unknown

structured_output.summary:
This PR moves the WebWrapper components (EventTypeWebWrapper and its tab wrappers, BookerWebWrapper, ConferencingAppsViewWebWrapper, SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper, AddMembersWithSwitchWebWrapper, DestinationCalendarSettingsWebWrapper) from packages/platform/atoms into apps/web. The goal is to let them import sibling web modules directly instead of going through @calcom/web from the atoms package. As part of that it moves sortHosts into @calcom/lib/bookings/hostGroupUtils, exposes three event-types hooks through @calcom/atoms package.json, and drops the WebWrapper exports from that package.json.

The direction is right and several parts are clean: the sortHosts callers are consolidated, the EventTypeWebWrapper imports now use the @calcom/atoms alias, and the moved files resolve to real targets. However, the diff as submitted has three blocking problems. BookerWebWrapper lost its useRouter import and declaration while four router.push calls remain, so those paths throw a ReferenceError and fail type-check. The sortHosts move silently flips the tie-breaker comparator for weighted round-robin, changing host ordering. And the packages/platform atoms package still imports or exports the deleted booker/index.ts and the moved ConferencingAppsViewWebWrapper, so the atoms build and type-check will break.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The BookerWebWrapper change removes a router declaration that is still used, which breaks booking-page navigation at runtime and fails type-check. The sortHosts comparator inversion changes round-robin host ordering for weighted tie cases, which is a silent behavior regression on a scheduling path. The leftover packages/platform references to deleted modules will break the atoms build. These need fixing before merge; the rest of the restructuring is sound.

architecture.overview:
Before this PR, the web app's event-type, booker, calendar and conferencing pages reached their UI through WebWrapper components that lived in packages/platform/atoms. Those wrappers imported the real web components back through @calcom/web, so the atoms package depended on apps/web and the two were coupled in both directions. The exported atoms (Booker, EventType, SelectedCalendarsSettings and others) were published from that package and consumed by both web pages and the platform.

This PR relocates the web-only wrappers into apps/web/modules (under event-types, bookings, apps, calendars) so they can use sibling imports. Shared logic that the wrappers needed from the atoms package, such as the event-types form hooks and sortHosts, is re-exposed through @calcom/atoms exports or moved into @calcom/lib. The app route files and module views are rewired to import the new locations. Platform-facing atoms that remain in packages/platform still exist, but any file that still pointed at the moved wrappers or at the removed booker entry point is now dangling.
steps: Start at the app entry points: app/(use-page-wrapper) routes and modules/ views such as team/type-view.tsx, d/[link]/d-type-view.tsx and users-type-public-view.tsx. They now import BookerWebWrapper, EventTypeWebWrapper, ConferencingAppsViewWebWrapper and SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper from apps/web/modules paths instead of @calcom/atoms.

Next, the moved WebWrapper components in apps/web/modules now import their web siblings with relative paths (for example ./Booker, ./EventType, ./AddMembersWithSwitch, ./tabs/...). The event-types tab wrappers are split into per-tab folders.

Shared hooks used by EventTypeWebWrapper (useEventTypeForm, useHandleRouteChange, useTabsNavigations) still live in packages/platform/atoms/event-types/hooks and are now exposed through new @calcom/atoms package.json exports.

sortHosts moves from HostEditDialogs.tsx into packages/lib/bookings/hostGroupUtils.ts, and the three callers (HostEditDialogs, EventTeamAssignmentTab, useEventTypeForm) import it from there. This is where the comparator inversion lives.

Removed from the atoms package: the WebWrapper package.json exports and the booker/index.ts barrel. The atoms package still has booker/export.ts and tsconfig entries that point at those files, which is where the dangling references come from.

findings.title: BookerWebWrapper calls router.push without a router in scope
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/web/modules/bookings/components/BookerWebWrapper.tsx`, the PR removed `useRouter` from the `next/navigation` import (line 4) and the `const router = useRouter();` declaration inside `BookerWebWrapperComponent` (around line 44), but `router.push` is still called at lines 193, 228, 232 and 238. Restore the `useRouter` import and the `router` declaration so those calls resolve. Leave the `useRef` removal as is, since nothing in the file uses it. Re-run type-check to confirm.

findings.title: sortHosts comparator inverted in the weighted tie-break branch
findings.fixPrompt: In `packages/lib/bookings/hostGroupUtils.ts`, the `sortHosts` function (starts at line 41) was moved from `apps/web/modules/event-types/components/HostEditDialogs.tsx`. In the weighted equal-weight branch (line 53), the comparator was changed to `priorityA - priorityB`, which reverses the original order. Restore it to `priorityB - priorityA` so it matches the original and the non-weighted branch. Then add unit tests for `sortHosts` covering both `isRRWeightsEnabled` true and false, including equal and unequal weights, to lock in the ordering.

findings.title: Dangling imports and exports to deleted atoms files break the platform build
findings.body:
The move deletes `packages/platform/atoms/booker/index.ts` and the ConferencingAppsViewWebWrapper, AddMembersWithSwitchWebWrapper and other WebWrapper modules from packages/platform/atoms, but several files still reference them:

- `packages/platform/atoms/package.json` still exports `./booker` as `./booker/index.ts` (line 58), and that file no longer exists.
- `packages/platform/atoms/tsconfig.json` still lists `booker/index.ts` and `booker/export.ts` (lines 72-73).
- `packages/platform/atoms/booker/export.ts` still does `export { BookerWebWrapper as Booker } from "./BookerWebWrapper"`, and that module has been moved out.
- `packages/platform/atoms/booker/Booker.docs.mdx` imports `./BookerWebWrapper` too.
- `packages/platform/atoms/connect/conferencing-apps/ConferencingAppsViewPlatformWrapper.tsx` imports the `BulkUpdatParams` and `UpdateUsersDefaultConferencingAppParams` types from `./ConferencingAppsViewWebWrapper`, which was moved.

The PR checklist asks whether anything depends on the removed `@calcom/atoms/booker` export. The answer is yes: the atoms dist entry (`booker/export.ts`) does. Type-check and the atoms build will fail until these references are updated or removed.

::diff{file="packages/platform/atoms/package.json" lines="54-62"}

::callout{type="warning"}
Either remove the `./booker` export and its tsconfig entries together with `booker/export.ts`, or point the export at a platform-local module that still exists. Move the shared types the platform wrapper needs into the atoms package or re-export them from the moved module, rather than importing from apps/web.
findings.fixPrompt: The PR deleted `packages/platform/atoms/booker/index.ts` and moved `BookerWebWrapper` and `ConferencingAppsViewWebWrapper` into apps/web, but several atoms files still reference them. Update `packages/platform/atoms/package.json` (the `./booker` export, line 58), `packages/platform/atoms/tsconfig.json` (lines 72-73), `packages/platform/atoms/booker/export.ts` and `booker/Booker.docs.mdx`, and `packages/platform/atoms/connect/conferencing-apps/ConferencingAppsViewPlatformWrapper.tsx` (type imports from `./ConferencingAppsViewWebWrapper`). Either remove the dead Booker entry point or point it at a platform-local module, and move any shared types into the atoms package. Verify with `yarn type-check:ci --force`.

findings.title: Deep relative imports still cross the apps/web to packages/platform boundary
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/web/components/apps/DestinationCalendarSettingsWebWrapper.tsx`, lines 3-4 import `AtomsWrapper` and `DestinationCalendarSettings` with deep relative paths (`../../../../packages/platform/...`) that cross the apps/web to packages/platform boundary. Replace them with `@calcom/atoms` package aliases, following the pattern used in `SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper.tsx`. This requires exporting `destination-calendar/DestinationCalendar` (and the AtomsWrapper if needed) from `packages/platform/atoms/package.json`, the same way the selected-calendars export was added.

findings.title: No test covers the sortHosts move or its tie-break behavior
findings.body:
The PR description says "I confirm automated tests are in place", but the diff adds no tests, and a search of the repo finds no test that imports `sortHosts` or `hostGroupUtils`. A function that controls host ordering in round-robin scheduling was moved between packages with no coverage. A unit test on the four ordering branches (weights enabled or disabled, with equal or unequal weights) would have caught the comparator inversion above.

::diff{file="packages/lib/bookings/hostGroupUtils.ts" lines="41-58"}
findings.fixPrompt: Add unit tests for `sortHosts` in `packages/lib/bookings/hostGroupUtils.ts` (see the function starting at line 41). Cover four cases: isRRWeightsEnabled true with unequal weights, true with equal weights and different priorities, and false with two different priorities, plus null weight and priority defaults (100 and 2). Assert the concrete sort order each produces, using `Array.prototype.sort` over a small host list. Follow the existing test layout for files in `packages/lib`.

findings.title: Formatting regression in EventTypeWebWrapper tab map
findings.body:
The `tabMap` JSX for the `setup` and `availability` tabs was re-indented to 8 spaces when the surrounding code uses the repo's standard 2-space indentation. Those lines now differ from the Prettier output and will fail the repo's format check. The change is purely cosmetic and does not affect behavior.

::code{file="apps/web/modules/event-types/components/EventTypeWebWrapper.tsx" lines="235-250"}
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/web/modules/event-types/components/EventTypeWebWrapper.tsx`, the `setup` and `availability` entries in `tabMap` (around lines 235-250) were re-indented to 8 spaces. Revert them to the surrounding 6-space JSX indentation so they match the other tab entries and Prettier output. Run the repo's formatter on this file.

findings.title: Trailing newline removed from moved tab wrapper files
findings.body:
`EventLimitsTabWebWrapper.tsx` and `EventRecurringWebWrapper.tsx` now end without a trailing newline (the diff shows "\ No newline at end of file"). Prettier and most lint configs expect one, so this will show up as a formatting diff. It is a one-character fix.

::code{file="apps/web/modules/event-types/components/tabs/limits/EventLimitsTabWebWrapper.tsx" lines="5-8"}
findings.fixPrompt: Add a trailing newline to `apps/web/modules/event-types/components/tabs/limits/EventLimitsTabWebWrapper.tsx` (line 8) and `apps/web/modules/event-types/components/tabs/recurring/EventRecurringWebWrapper.tsx` (last line). Both files currently end with `export default ...;` and no newline. Run the repo's formatter to confirm.

findings.title: Consolidating sortHosts into a shared lib module
findings.body:
Moving `sortHosts` out of a React component file (`HostEditDialogs.tsx`) and into `@calcom/lib/bookings/hostGroupUtils.ts` is a good change. The function is pure and is now used by three callers across apps/web and the atoms package, and they no longer have to import a UI module to get it. The only problem is the comparator inversion noted above.

::diff{file="apps/web/modules/event-types/components/tabs/assignment/EventTeamAssignmentTab.tsx" lines="17-17"}

findings.title: Web-only wrappers moved to the app that owns their dependencies
findings.body:
The moved wrappers import web-only modules, such as `@calcom/web/modules/event-types/components/EventType` and the `app/` route actions, so they belong in `apps/web`. Their relative imports now resolve inside `apps/web/modules`, which removes the circular dependency where the atoms package imported the web app through `@calcom/web`. Keeping the change scoped to moving files, with the tab wrappers split into per-tab folders, makes the new layout easy to follow.

::file{file="apps/web/modules/event-types/components/EventTypeWebWrapper.tsx"}
